questions.q: What is the programme mainly about?
options: Wild animals returning to towns and cities during lockdown
How farmers in Kenya protect their crops from elephants
How much food elephants need to survive
Why honey is becoming more expensive
questions.why: Beth says they'll hear about farmers in Kenya keeping their food safe from hungry wild animals.

questions.q: Why are people and wild animals competing more for space?
options: Animals are moving to cities for fun
Farmers are keeping more animals
New laws protect wild animals more than they protect people
There are more people and less natural habitat
questions.why: Neil says human populations increase while natural habitats decline.

questions.q: According to Victor Ndombi, when do the elephants usually raid crops?
options: In the dry season
Only at night during the winter
During the rainy crop season
All year round equally
questions.why: He says the crop raids usually happen during the crop season, the rainy season.

questions.q: What are the elephants looking for when they come to the farms?
options: Green food like maize and beans, and water
Somewhere safe and quiet to sleep at night
Shade from the sun
Other elephants
questions.why: Victor says they want green pasture and nutritious foods like maize and beans, and water.

questions.q: What does reporter Michael Kaloki notice about Victor?
options: He sounds calm, as the raids are normal there
He sounds very frightened of the elephants
He is angry with the national park
He wants all the elephants to be moved far away
questions.why: He says Victor sounds very calm – “it's just a way of life for the people out here.”

questions.q: Why have the crop raids become more frequent?
options: There are more elephants than ever
Farmers are now growing sweeter crops that elephants love
Elephants need water and the park can't pay to fix fences
Tourists are feeding the elephants
questions.why: Neil says elephants are desperate for water and the park lacks money to fix broken fences.

questions.q: What solution does Victor's team use?
options: Electric fences
Guards with guns
Moving the farms away
Beehive fences
questions.why: They install beehive fences; folklore says elephants are scared of bees.

questions.q: Why do Beth and Neil feel a little sorry for the elephants?
options: They are often stung and badly hurt by the angry bees
They need so much food but are kept away from it
They are losing their honey
They are being killed by farmers
questions.why: Beth feels sorry for them, and Neil adds, “especially because they need to eat so much.”
